text:
maria: Heads-up: apiserver 5xx spike in eu-central1 around 11:12 UTC. Nodes can't reach kube-apiserver via internal LB, seeing DNS NXDOMAIN for `kubernetes.default.svc.cluster.local` on several nodes. Proxy pool (envoy) showing TCP resets.
rohit: I'm seeing the same — controller-manager restarted twice, leader election delays. Putting @oncall on it.
oncall-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-0473 apiserver-dns-flap-euc1
elyse: Can someone run `kubectl get endpoints -n default kubernetes -o wide` from a master? also `dig +short kubernetes.default.svc.cluster.local @10.3.0.10` on a node.
sam: ran dig from a node: returns nothing intermittently. `systemd-resolved` shows transient failures. iptables NAT looks okay.
rohit: logs from CoreDNS show: `context deadline exceeded` and upstream 169.254.169.254 timeouts.
maria: interesting — we've had recent NAT gateway churn in euc1. Could be SNAT port exhaustion for kube-apiserver <-> nodes egress. GPU attach jobs are failing with `rpc error: code = Unavailable`.
elyse: controller-manager backlog shows many attach/detach operations queued. This will affect Dedicated GPU provisioning and scale-up.
sam: quick debug output from a node: ```
# iptables-save | grep -E "KUBE-" || true
-A KUBE-SERVICES -d 10.96.0.1/32 -p tcp -m comment --comment "kubernetes" --dport 443 -j KUBE-SVC-XXXXX
# ss -tn state close
ESTAB 0 0 10.3.5.2:443 10.3.5.12:34567 timer:(keepalive,10sec/0)
```
rohit: temp mitigation: increasing apiserver replicas from 3 -> 5 behind LB, and bumping LB healthcheck timeout to 10s. Also routing a small percentage of control traffic to eu-west1 fallback.
maria: also noticed a canary envoy change last night that reduced keepalive to 10s. Rolling that back now.
deploy-bot: Reverted envoy-config canary (canary_id=envoy-2026-042).
rohit: rollback in place. Observability shows 5xx rate falling. controller-manager queue length is decreasing but attach failures linger.
elyse: short-term for GPU jobs: bump provisioner retry to 3x with exponential backoff and requeue logic. That should prevent immediate job failures while we debug NAT/conn issues.
sam: added retry patch to the provisioner, canary deployed at 1%. Will ramp as we validate. Cost impact should be small vs failed jobs.
maria: next actions: investigate NAT port usage (SNAT table), add node-local DNS caching in euc1, and audit LB BGP session metrics. rohit please open a postmortem and tag networking + infra.
rohit: will create a postmortem ticket with timeline, logs, and proposed mitigations. tagging @maria and @elyse for timeline input.
maria: will add a blameless timeline and attach kube-apiserver/coredns logs. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
